no idea what's going to happen in terms of future. No idea how this may play out. I have
as an interest in education. Don't you? I find this very interesting. If you do that at a

More people. And it's the combination of all the things we've talked about, technology
and its transformation effect on work and demography and the huge explosion in population.

if you had a degree, you had a job. If you didn't have a job, it's because you didn't
